newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Primac says IAMA bid inadequate.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Primac says IAMA bid inadequate.

text.p: Brisbane-based Primac Holdings Ltd said on Monday that IAMA Ltd's takeover bid announced on Friday of nine IAMA shares for every 10 Primac shares appeared to be totally inadequate.
IAMA shares ended two cents higher on Friday at A$2.82 while Primac was unchanged at A$3.10, its year high.
Primac said its directors had formally recommended shareholders not take any action.
Primac has 16.96 million shares on issue and a market capitalisation of A$52.57 million.
IAMA said in a substantial shareholder notice on Friday that it held 16.81 percent of Primac, a pastoral company.
